findings.evidence: `rg` shows precomplex one-sided constructors at lines 91 and 97, while the abstract namespace only has `mem_join_disjSum_iff` at 138 and `disjSum_mem_join` at 144; `Basic.lean:47-52` makes faces nonempty, so the two-sided abstract lemma cannot be specialized with `∅`.
findings.fix: Add `AbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inl_mem_join {s} (hs : s ∈ K) : s.map Embedding.inl ∈ join K L` and the corresponding `map_inr_mem_join`, mirroring the precomplex API.
findings.issue: `AbstractSimplicialComplex.join` exposes only `disjSum_mem_join`, which requires faces from both factors; it has no abstract analogues of `map_inl_mem_join`/`map_inr_mem_join`, so consumers cannot directly embed a face from one factor into the join because `∅` is not a face of an abstract simplicial complex.

summary: The abstract join surface is missing the one-sided face-introduction lemmas needed to use the construction without unfolding the membership characterization.
